AWPTCM-T43817.objective:
• The cable-diagnostics TDR test can be started on an interface with an active link; the link goes down during the test and recovers afterward.
  • Completed VCT test results are displayed with per-pair status (OK) and approximate length.
  • Each new VCT test run updates the displayed results (latest test is shown).
  • The clear test cable-diagnostics tdr command removes previous results; show reports "No test results available".
  • VCT test completes within a short time (≤5 seconds on supported hardware).
  • VCT functions correctly on both standard and combo ports.

steps.description: Note: No related ART tests. Primary coverage from TestLink AWP-17987 (VCT Basic Feature Test) and siblings in Virtual Cable Tester suite. Related cases linked in Traceability.

Connect DUT to a link partner with traffic flowing. Start VCT test on the interface and confirm the link goes down during the test, then recovers. Verify show test cable-diagnostics tdr displays per-pair status and length.
Run VCT test on an interface connected to itself (loopback). Confirm the show command reflects the latest test results, not prior ones, and that the test completes in ≤5 seconds.
Issue clear test cable-diagnostics tdr followed by show. Confirm results are cleared and the show output reports 'No test results available'.
If the platform has combo ports, repeat the basic VCT test sequence on a combo port and confirm identical behavior (link down, results, clear).
